cohort: 75 women with Systemic Sclerosis (SSc) diagnosed by ACR/EULAR 2013 criteria, registered at a tertiary care center between 2010-2016, with pregnancies occurring before or after disease onset
finding: Pregnancies after systemic sclerosis diagnosis were associated with a higher rate of both maternal and fetal complications compared to pregnancies before disease onset.
mod_finding: Indian SSc patients had a higher frequency of lower section cesarean sections compared to the Italian cohort.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (LBW) was reported as an outcome
